gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-lxgw-marker-goth: LXGW Marker Gothic is a plain sans with a wide-open c and slight stroke contrast, beneath the uniform curves of Shantell Sans. Over pages of text it settles into an easy, unfussy rhythm.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-1: Loose, hand-drawn energy up top, flat fineliner lines below. M PLUS 1 handles steady reading with big open e and a shapes, while Shantell Sans handles attention with its single fixed nib width.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-rounded-1: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads soft and approachable, its terminals stopping short of curling back in, beneath Shantell Sans's ruler-straight lines. One loud, one gentle, they share the page without a fuss.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps every small counter unclogged. The pair's best quality is uniform strokes up top, where Shantell Sans's horizontals are no thinner than its verticals, against a body sans of low contrast.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-noto-sans-nko: Shantell Sans twists spaghetti-like, same-width strokes into wide-mouthed letters. Noto Sans NKo, a plain sans with see-through c openings, goes down easily over many lines of text, quiet and modern.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans is a sans-serif with a wide gap at the e's terminal and lines that keep their thickness in every direction. Shantell Sans brings the personality while this body just keeps quiet.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-roboto-flex: Shantell Sans looks like letters bent from one length of wire, wide-mouthed and expressive. Roboto Flex handles the quiet work, its wide c slot keeping text approachable, where Shantell Sans handles the showmanship.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarala: Wide-mouthed letters up top, neon-glass lines below. Sarala, a friendly sans with distinct gaps in its letterforms, keeps a full page of text easy to follow beside Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro keeps open aperture curves across the whole alphabet, a modern sans under Shantell Sans's round-tipped-pen letters. The best thing here is hand-drawn warmth meeting tidy, low-contrast lettering.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-varela: Shantell Sans writes every letter with one fixed nib width. Varela, a modern sans-serif whose t shares one width between crossbar and stem, gives that loose handwriting a tidy, approachable partner.
